item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00038","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C10","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 is a concrete and material drafting template for the child. Both concern a named commission member previously exempted by a September 19, 1946 executive order for an indefinite period limited by the member's term; both then recite the term's expiration and conclude that the public interest requires a further exemption. This distinctive factual and operative sequence goes well beyond generic retirement-exemption boilerplate. C10 and C23 also concern further exemptions, but compress the prior exemption and term facts into a single recital and therefore match the child's structure less closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Claude L. Draper, a member of the Federal Power Commission, was exempted by Executive Order No. 978 of September 19, 1946, from compulsory retirement for age for an indefinite period of time not extending beyond the duration of his appointment or term of office","parent_excerpt":"Clyde B. Aitchison, a member of the Interstate Commerce Commission, was by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of September 19, 1946, exempted from compulsory retirement for age for an indefinite period of time not extending beyond the duration of his appointment or term of office","explanation":"Nearly verbatim and unusually specific recital, with the official, commission membership, prior order date, exemption type, and term-linked duration adapted to Draper."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS his present term of office will expire June 22, 1951","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS his term of office will expire on December 31, 1949","explanation":"The same second-stage recital identifies expiration of the prior term as the reason a further exemption is needed."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS the said Claude L. Draper has been appointed for a further five-year term of office","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS sections 11 and 24 of the Interstate Commerce Act, as amended, provide that upon the expiration of his term of office a Commissioner of the Interstate Commerce Commission shall continue to serve until his successor is appointed and shall have qualified","explanation":"Both insert a third recital explaining the official's continued service after the expiring term, though the legal mechanism differs."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that the said Claude L. Draper be further exempted from compulsory retirement as provided below","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that the said Clyde B. Aitchison be further exempted from compulsory retirement for age as provided below","explanation":"The concluding public-interest recital is essentially identical and preserves the distinctive 'further exempted' formulation."}]}
